name: Hi no Tsuki
source:
End of Edo period.
Main character travels with a master of the sword searching for Kanzaki who killed protagonist's adopted father. In the middle of the trip they get caught up in a case in a small port town. In the mids of investigation the name of Kanzaki shows up, but in a new context - linked to gods, opus and castle lord. The hour of revenge draws near.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
幕末。
主人公与一位剑术高手一同旅行，寻找杀害其养父的神崎。途中，他们被卷入一座港口小镇发生的案件。调查过程中，神崎的名字再次出现，却与神祇、秘典和城主联系在了一起。复仇的时刻正逐渐逼近。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
